conclusions: The five-role workflow completed the repair, using its separately declared team budget
Proposals and review account for about 79 percent of recorded complete wall time on this tiny task
The two declared checks took about 0.04 seconds; checking was not the main elapsed-time cost in this pilot
The run would miss a 150-second whole-team deadline; do not count it as a solo M3 success
No solo run was measured; Luna implementation time alone cannot serve as a complete solo baseline
Role wall time includes CLI activity and waiting; it does not isolate provider inference time or charges

comparison_controls.single: One pinned solver session, followed by the same final checker; no planning, proposals, review or repair sessions
comparison_controls.luna_team: The complete team workflow with Luna explicitly assigned to every role
comparison_controls.mixed_team: The complete team workflow with the original explicit Luna, GLM and Kimi assignments
comparison_controls.budget: Every condition declares one complete-run ceiling; all stages share the remaining time
comparison_controls.status: The comparisons have scripted controls; no live comparison has run
